newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon ups SmithKline target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon ups SmithKline target.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Wednesday it raised its 12-month price target on SmithKline Beecham Plc to 1,400p in the wake of Tuesday's strong second-quarter results.
The previous target was not given and analysts at the investment bank were not immediately available for comment.
Salomon trimmed its 1997 earnings per share estimate for the company by four percent to 40.5p, mainly reflecting sterling strength, but repeated a "buy" rating on the stock.
SmithKline shares were up 18-1/2p at 12.38 stg by 0926 GMT.
